459171.overview:
A challenging puzzle game that introduces the player to the world of building basic chemical elements. The goal of the game is to complete the correct structure of the molecule of a given atom within a certain time. 

After starting, a game board with atoms scattered around it will appear on the screen. Pressing the [I] key will show the shape to be formed from the atoms. The hand, visible on the board, is used to catch the atoms and move them in the selected direction only in a straight line. It will be possible to change direction only when an atom stops on an obstacle. This method of control requires logical thinking and anticipation of the next moves. 

There may also be obstacles on the board in the form of crystals, which destroy when an atom hits them. Usually after four such hits the crystal disappears. After arranging the chemical structure, the player will be moved to the next board with a more difficult pattern to arrange.

459902.overview:
Hot Pursuit is a driving / shooting game released for the ZX81 and the SAM Coupé that features three completely different stages. 

The first stage is a 3D driving stage, and the object is to collect time spheres falling from the sky, while avoiding obstacles and other vehicles. The second stage is overhead racing, and the objective is to pursue and catch the suspect's car. The third stage is a warehouse shootout against a drug baron.

459903.overview:
Have You Lost Your Marbles Deluxe is a puzzle game released in 1994 for the SAM Coupé. The game features vibrant graphics created by Pickasso and music composed by Lee Willis. Players navigate through intricate mazes, collecting coins and avoiding obstacles.

The game challenges players to solve puzzles using strategic thinking. Each level presents unique challenges, requiring careful planning and precise movements to progress.
